# Step 2: the filter chain (generated by r2_filter.py)

1. Placement of the second resonance: the chains of filt.py (today's network; first stage only; the
   user's placement with f2 above the switching frequency, undamped and damped; f2 inside the band;
   the recommended f2 near 10 kHz with three ways of damping it): resonances, the second stage's
   attenuation v_pa / v_uc at f_sw = 40-150 kHz and at the harmonics, and the passive output impedance
   in the audio band above the loop's reach (2-20 kHz; the closed loop below that is r3).
2. Switching residue at the power amp's input (after W04 and its 100 nF) at the TCM operating points:
   the half-bridge's rectangular switch-node voltage (harmonics 1-40) through the averaged network,
   per chain, ESR corners 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6 ohm (hot / nominal / cold electrolytic).
3. The first capacitor's ripple current (electrolytic and film share by impedance), ESR heating and life.
4. Tolerances (L +-20 %, film C +-10 %, electrolytic -10 / +30 %, ESR corners) and the frequency band.
5. The input side: the bridges' pulsed input current through the drawn input filter (C201 / C206 47 uF,
   100 nF, 1 nF; L101 33 uH; C101 47 uF; PSU 0.3 ohm + 1 uH): ripple on the raw node and current in
   the PSU cable, one bridge and both at 0 / 180 degrees, against the hard-switched design (M15).

## 1. Placement of the second resonance

Resonances: peaks of the passive output impedance (load open, ESR 0.1 ohm). H2 = v_pa / v_uc, the second stage's own transfer (< 1 attenuates, > 1 amplifies); the switching frequency moves over 40-150 kHz (r1). |Zo| max: passive output impedance 2-20 kHz (below about 2 kHz the loop sets it, r3).

| same L2 / C2, Rd straight across L2 (3.9 ohm) | 1024 / 13.82, 9026 / 4.55, 698170 / 5.12 | 0.222 / 0.144 / 0.085 / 0.055 | 0.107 / 0.070 | 4.52 at 9019 |

Reading: an LC section only attenuates above its resonance (H2 -> (f2 / f)^2), and amplifies around it (by its Q). With f2 = 200 kHz, above the band, the second stage gains 1.1-4.3x over 40-150 kHz undamped (1.1-1.6x damped) and only starts to help above about 250 kHz: at the switching frequency it adds nothing. With f2 inside the band (60 kHz) the variable frequency sweeps through the peak. Today's stage (27.7 kHz, Rd straight across L2) gives 0.9 at 40 kHz and 0.18 at 150 kHz: the parallel resistor makes the asymptote -20 dB/decade. The recommended stage, f2 near 9 kHz with an Rd-Cd leg, gives about 0.04 at 40 kHz and 0.003 at 150 kHz with the passive output impedance peak at about 3.5 ohm (R2: 5 ohm).

Requirement R8: 500 mV on V_ANODE, 200 mV on V_SCREEN. Proposed target for this study: <= 20 mV p-p at either power amp input at every point with the nominal ESR, <= 50 mV at the cold-ESR corner (today's design: 7 mV at 400 V, 59 mV at 200 V; r4 shows what reaches the speaker).

## 3. First capacitor: ripple current, heating, life (recommended chain)

C1 = 100 uF / 500 V electrolytic (snap-in, returned through the I_C shunt) in parallel with 4.7 uF / 630 V film. Currents rms (switching harmonics; the audio-frequency load current adds a few tens of mA rms).

| Point | f_sw (kHz) | inductor ripple rms (A) | electrolytic rms (A), ESR 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6 | film rms (A) at ESR 0.3 | electrolytic loss at ESR(hot) 0.1-0.15 ohm (W) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400 V 0.70 A, raw 420 V | 40 | 0.62 | 0.58 / 0.52 / 0.44 | 0.34 | 0.04 |
| 400 V 0.30 A, raw 430 V | 94 | 0.39 | 0.35 / 0.26 / 0.17 | 0.29 | 0.01 |
| 400 V no load | 150 | 0.24 | 0.20 / 0.12 / 0.07 | 0.21 | 0.00 |
| 200 V 0.35 A | 150 | 0.92 | 0.84 / 0.53 / 0.30 | 0.76 | 0.09 |
| 150 V 0.20 A | 150 | 0.85 | 0.77 / 0.47 / 0.27 | 0.70 | 0.07 |
| 20 V 0.5 A (start-up) | 49 | 0.50 | 0.47 / 0.41 / 0.33 | 0.30 | 0.03 |
| screen 390 V 0.18 A | 53 | 0.32 | 0.30 / 0.26 / 0.20 | 0.19 | 0.01 |
| screen 146 V 0.08 A | 150 | 0.39 | 0.35 / 0.22 / 0.13 | 0.32 | 0.01 |

Electrolytic (100 uF / 500 V / 105 C snap-in, 22 x 40 or 25 x 35 class): ripple rating about 1.0-1.3 A rms at 120 Hz / 105 C, x1.4 at 10-100 kHz, x1.7-2 at 85 C ambient: about 2.4-3 A rms allowed at the board's 80 C. The worst 0.95 A rms takes about 30-40 % of it; 0.1-0.15 W of ESR heating raises the core about 2-4 K (the R_th of a 22 x 40 can is about 20-25 K/W). Life (doubling per 10 K): 5000 h at 105 C -> about 5000 x 2^((105 - 84) / 10) = 21,000 h at an 84 C core, 10,000 h parts -> 42,000 h. Film alternative for C1 (all the ripple in film, MKP 0.1 % tan d): 2 x 10 uF / 500 V DC-link film (about 42 x 20 x 40 mm each) gives f1 = 2.4 kHz with 220 uH, too high for the delayed loop to damp (r3) and less audio-band reservoir; so the electrolytic stays as the reservoir and carries the ripple, with the 4.7 uF film in parallel for the high-frequency end and the cold-ESR corner.

The recommended stage has no resonance in the switching band at any tolerance corner; its attenuation at the band's low end varies +-25 % with the tolerances, the residue stays below the target. A variable switching frequency is harmless to it (it sits 4x below the lowest f_sw); a series trap at f_sw would be useless with a frequency that moves 4:1.

The input filter's own resonance (L101 33 uH with C101 and the bridge capacitors, about 3 kHz, |Z| peak 0.9 ohm) is unchanged and far below the bridges' negative input resistance (V^2 / P = 616 ohm at 300 W): it needs no active damping. The TCM bridge draws a larger input ripple current (its inductor ripple is 2 A p-p instead of 0.16 A); the input capacitors C201 / C206 carry it (rated about 1.6 A at 70 C, T3) and L101 + C101 keep it off the cable.
